english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something that is only so-so and not very good.
Use this when indifferent describes quality as only so-so or mediocre, not a person's attitude.

examples.english: The food at this restaurant is mediocre.
examples.traditional: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食麻麻哋。

examples.english: This movie was indifferent at best.
